definitions.explanation: A mound or ridge of sand formed by wind, found in deserts, along coasts, and at riverbanks.

examples.japanese: {砂丘|さきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: To walk on a sand dune.

examples.japanese: {鳥取|とっとり}{砂丘|さきゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{砂丘|さきゅう}だ。
examples.english: The Tottori Sand Dunes are the most famous sand dunes in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作|つく}り{出|だ}す→作り出す：11634_tsukuridasu⟧{砂丘|さきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美|うつく}しく→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The patterns the wind creates on the sand dunes are beautiful and change every day.

notes:
Composed of {砂|さ} (sand) + {丘|きゅう} (hill, mound). Japan's most famous sand dunes are the {鳥取砂丘|とっとりさきゅう} in Tottori Prefecture, which are a major tourist destination and a designated natural monument.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {砂丘|さきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk on sand dunes
- ⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧{砂丘|さきゅう}: coastal sand dune
- {砂丘|さきゅう}⟦{地帯|ちたい}→地帯：04057_chitai⟧: dune area
- {砂丘|さきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風紋|ふうもん}: wind ripples on sand dunes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{砂漠|さばく}→砂漠：09508_sabaku⟧: desert (a much larger arid landscape; {砂丘|さきゅう} are individual formations)
- ⟦{砂浜|すなはま}→砂浜：12333_sunahama⟧: sandy beach (flat, along the shoreline)
- ⟦{丘|おか}→丘：02183_oka⟧: hill (general; not necessarily sand)
